notes.name: Handover checklist
notes.body: vitals, drips, allergies, pending labs, family calls, falls risk, who needs a walk

notes.name: Common dosage reminders
notes.body: paracetamol every six hours max four grams, check the renal flag before enoxaparin

notes.name: Night shift survival
notes.body: eat at two, caffeine stops at four, blackout curtains, magnesium before sleep

notes.name: CPR course notes 2025
notes.body: thirty compressions then two breaths, hundred to hundred twenty a minute, switch every two minutes

notes.name: Ward meeting 28 October
notes.body: new pump training in December, holiday rota published Friday, Oddzialowa wants volunteers

notes.name: Mama's bigos
notes.body: sauerkraut, three kinds of meat, prunes, cook for three days, better on the second

notes.name: Pierogi ruskie
notes.body: potato and white cheese filling, fried onion on top, dough rests thirty minutes

notes.name: Zurek
notes.body: sourdough starter, smoked sausage, marjoram, boiled egg in the bowl

notes.name: Shakshuka for flat dinner
notes.body: tinned tomatoes, peppers, cumin, six eggs, feta, bread

notes.name: Five-a-side tactics
notes.body: diamond not square, Tomek Maj stays in goal, Marcin presses high, no long balls on the Orlik

notes.name: League table notes
notes.body: fourth place, two points behind Wisla Old Boys, next match is the derby

notes.name: Kit colours
notes.body: blue shirts, white shorts, Piotr has the bibs, Darek washes them in December

notes.name: Diary entry - hard shift
notes.body: lost a patient at four am, Magda made tea, cried in the stairwell and then did the rounds

notes.name: Diary entry - good Tuesday
notes.body: won four three, scored twice, pizza with Darek and Bartek, walked home along the Vistula

notes.name: London ideas
notes.body: Christmas market at Hyde Park, Kasia wants fondue, the Tate Modern, a pub with James

notes.name: Gift ideas for Kasia and James
notes.body: a Polish pottery mug set for Kasia, craft vodka for James, smoked oscypek

notes.name: Flat rules
notes.body: dishes the same day, quiet after eleven, bins on Fridays, cleaning rota on the fridge

notes.name: Boiler instructions
notes.body: pressure should sit at one and a half bar, reset button on the left, call Pan Stanislaw if it clicks

notes.name: Monthly budget
notes.body: rent 1800 split three ways, food 1200, transport 150, football 120, save 1500

notes.name: Gym plan
notes.body: monday chest and back, thursday legs, shoulder rehab stretches every morning

notes.name: Physio advice
notes.body: band pull-aparts three sets of fifteen, no overhead work for two weeks, ice after shifts

notes.name: Stag do ideas
notes.body: go-karting, a day in the mountains, Marcin books the pub, budget 600 each

notes.name: Zakopane plan
notes.body: pension near Krupowki, ski rental in the village, dinner at the bacówka on Saturday

notes.name: Old shopping list
notes.body: bread, tea, tomatoes
